training_format_policy: Within each label, stable sorted group position plus epoch modulo 3. Exactly 128 groups per label/style each completed epoch. Every original sees JSON, prose and label-led source rationale once if all three epochs complete; original early stopping remains active. Exact bare-label answers remain unseen during fitting because the unchanged generic data gate rejects stock negatives.
selection: Validation only with all original 80%/70% and baseline-improvement gates, minimum label/format accuracy then worst BT loss. No original audit metric selects a candidate.
baseline: Fit once on all three training-only views, freeze emitted coefficient bytes before validation and audit. Reproduction consumes those bytes, never a fresh fit.
hypothesis_basis: B3 prepare rejected a training-only answer baseline. Correct source responses with substantive accepted/excluded verdict roles and equal word bags. Keep every source and quality threshold unchanged. Exact bare labels remain unseen transfer inputs.
audit_boundary: Reuse the exact source-only audit frozen in B3 prepare before any foundation model was loaded. Its original run failed the train-only shortcut gate. No audit access or scoring happened. Verify the actual audit and group hashes before model work; all exposed earlier groups stay excluded.
scope: English Civil Comments extremes; not universal moderation policy.
response_design: Both responses contain a verdict and an excluded verdict, plus original source evidence. Paired role reversal preserves exact lexical multisets and length; meaning depends on ordered verdict roles, not lexical tells.
